problem: pack now reverses the whole concatenated body instead of each stream in place, reversing stream order too, so blocks from main and the branch silently decode to wrong data in both directions with no version marker or error, and no test exists to catch it.

Production module now imports the bare-named reference_impl module, so import fails with ModuleNotFoundError wherever that file is not shipped and any same-named module earlier on sys.path is executed instead.

The stream-length bound is read from _ref.MAX_TABLE_LENGTH instead of the local MAX_TABLE_LENGTH, so another module controls this format's validation limit and a raised value leads to OverflowError at to_bytes instead of ValueError.
The jump-table size is hardcoded as 6 at lines 38, 41 and 43 while TABLE_SIZE and MAX_TABLE_LENGTH are left defined but unused, so changing either constant silently has no effect.
pack's error messages at lines 27 and 31 dropped the actual stream count, stream length and limit that main reported, which weakens diagnostics and makes them inconsistent with split and join.
unpack's error messages at lines 39 and 42 were cut down to 'short block' and 'lengths exceed block', losing the expected table size and the length-versus-block-size context.
